description: Give a session the claims of its repository in layers, by boom hook session-start: the rules in full, the other claims by name, and a menu; nothing where boom finds no repository, or where its delivery at session start is off. Before an agent edits a file, run boom hook pre-tool-use: it stops a write that holds an old word of an accepted term, and it stops the first edit of a file in a context to give the rules of that context. The agent then makes the edit again.
